name: @pipeworx/mcp-airquality

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: Check current air quality at a location (latitude/longitude or city name, e.g., "40.7128, -74.0060" or "New York"). Returns US AQI score, PM2.5, PM10, CO, NO2, and ozone levels.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Get hourly air quality forecast for a location. Returns US AQI, PM2.5, and PM10 predictions. Use to plan activities or alert users to upcoming poor air conditions.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-airquality forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the airquality pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
